session_isolation.evidence: Backend owner isolation and three independent browser contexts; zero cross-session plan IDs in isolated load cases.

ownership_enforcement.evidence: Foreign plan list/detail/replan/approval/cost/memo/CSV/PDF and foreign participation checks return 404 in session tests.

rate_limit_fairness.evidence: Isolated 1, 3, and 5 visitor flows completed with zero 429; one visitor is limited independently in the session test.

global_safety.evidence: 120/min global ceiling and 4-active/6-waiting/15-second solver gate remain enabled; excess solver work returns retryable 503.

visitor_10.evidence: The configured bounded solver queue rejected two visitors with retryable 503.

passed: concurrent duplicate replan returns the same child
approval versus replan has one valid winner and a 409 loser
not_verified: decline versus restore under concurrent tabs
database restart during an in-flight request

security.evidence: Opaque 256-bit session token hashed at rest; HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax/Secure-on-HTTPS cookie; strict CORS; explicit public allowlist; private pilot writes denied; cross-session plan ownership tested.
security.scope_note: Anonymous demo sessions are not authentication; same-origin XSS can act within the current demo session.

render_verification.note: Live homepage and API health were read successfully before a new deployment; no new task SHA had been deployed yet.

physical_mobile.note: adb devices -l found no Android device; responsive browser tests passed.

remaining_limits: Ten local visitors: 8/10 completed because the bounded solver gate returned two 503 responses.
Rate and solver limits are process-local and multiply across API processes or instances.
The Render Free /tmp filesystem is ephemeral; a filesystem reset invalidates existing demo plans and sessions recover by issuing a replacement session.
Live load and production latency were not measured.
Physical device behavior was not verified.
